name: op-version-zero-does-not-match-scoped-rule
description: WRIT-275: opMatchesRule's op-side wildcard is dead through the log (the op-envelope schema requires op_version >= 1 and a non-empty object_type on every op that reaches it) and is removed here. This vector pins the removal directly: a rule scoped to op_version 1 and object_type 'acme.widget', against a single op that carries neither (a shape only a caller-built op fed straight to Fold, never the log, can produce). Before the fix, a zero op_version or empty object_type on the op side was itself treated as a wildcard, so this op would have matched the rule and folded 'title'. After the fix, the rule does not govern the op at all -- it matches no declared rule -- so the op contributes no field write and is quarantined into unknown_ops (spec/fold.md §7) rather than folding.
